In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of 50% of Coconut shell powder (CSC) and 50% FEF to the rubber matrix has a significant effect on improving the properties of the composites.
the 50% of Coconut Shell Powder (CSP) has better mechanical properties and it can be used as a filler material in rubber compounds.
the 50% of coconut shell powder is the optimum amount of filler to be incorporated into the rubber matrix for achieving better mechanical properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
50% of Coconut Shell Powder (CSP) in the compound has better mechanical properties than 25% and other combinations of composites.
the addition of 50% of FEF and CSP in KNB rubber has improved the mechanical properties like hardness, tensile strength, elongation and specific gravity.
the addition of 50% CSP to KNB rubber is the best combination to get good mechanical properties.

the use of coconut shell powder (50% CSP) in the compounding of KNBR is more cost effective and it is a better choice for industrial applications.
the use of coconut shell powder in the production of rubber compounds will help reduce the environmental pollution.
, we can use coconut shell as filler in the rubber compounds.
